## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-mach`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-mach -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `items.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `mach.json`
- `meta.json`
- `items.jsonl`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`
- `machbench-draft.json`
- See the Data tab for all 9 files.

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

# GSPC — machinery conformity bank (MachBench)

Council of AI measurement bank. Measurement, not certification.

**Bank.** Frozen split. Live `n` is the matching axis on `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`, not a Hub score. **Not a certificate.** Art 50 (EUR-Lex): 2 August 2026 live; marking grace 2 December 2026.


**Live measurement.** This bank stands behind the `machinery-conformity` row of the live GSPC board: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=machinery-conformity` (family, kind, status and n are on that row, never typed here; the whole board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`). Measurement, not certification.

## Dataset facts (checked 2026-11-20)

- Kaggle version 4, last updated 2026-10-06.
- 9 files, 53,135 bytes. File types: .json (4), .jsonl (3), .md (1), .yaml (1).
- Hugging Face twin: [csoai/gspc-mach](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-mach). 8 of 9 files have the same byte size there.
- Expected update frequency: never.
